question: The first cotton textile mill in Ahmedabad was started in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1861.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ahmedabad's first cotton textile mill,** the Ahmedabad Cotton Mill,** started production on **May 30th, 1861.**
 
• It was founded by** Rao Bahadur Ranchhodlal Chhotalal,** an entrepreneur in **Ahmedabad.**** **
 
• It was a spinning factory with** 2,500 spindles** and employed **63 workers. **
 
• It catered to the local handloom weavers' yarn requirements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first cotton textile mill in India **was established at** Fort Glastor near Kolkata in 1818.**
 
• **Large-scale production of cotton** started in **Mumbai in 1854.**
 
• **India's first successful mechanized textile mill** was instituted in the **city of Mumbai**, then known as Bombay, in the** year 1854.**
 
• There were several factors that led to the rapid expansion of the industry in the region, the region had **a warm, moist climate that was suitable for the industry.**
